title: Tailwise Plus Fee Collection: Retry and Past-Due Grace Periods by Tier (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
When a Tailwise Plus fee cannot be collected, the **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** membership passes through two fixed periods: a retry period, during which the declined fee is retried, and then a past-due grace period. The length of each depends on the tier, as does whether paid benefits continue while the membership is past due.

| Tier | Retry period for a declined fee | Past-due grace period | Paid benefits and points earning continue while past due |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days | No |
| Pals Rewards Insider | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days | No |
| Pals Rewards VIP | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days | No |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | 3 calendar days | 14 calendar days | No |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | 7 calendar days | 30 calendar days | No |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 7 calendar days | 30 calendar days | No |

## What the figures mean

- **Retry period**: the calendar days a declined fee is retried before the membership becomes past due.
- **Past-due grace period**: the calendar days in past due after which the paid tier lapses to the free tier earned by spend.
- **Benefits while past due**: on every tier the answer is No, so while a membership is past due its paid benefits and its points earning do not continue.

The free tiers charge no fee, so their zero periods never come into play.

## Comparing tiers (hypothetical dates)

Suppose a fee is declined and the retries fail. On Tailwise Plus Monthly the retries run for 3 calendar days and the grace period for 14; on Tailwise Plus Annual and Tailwise Plus Premier Annual the retries run for 7 calendar days and the grace period for 30.
